Specification: This module is a small test specification for the Bags module and related TLC-evaluable operators. It defines a set S, several bags derived from S, a simple mapping function F1, and an invariant-like operator Inv that performs many assertions and prints to check the expected behavior of bag conversion, bag union, bag subtraction, subbag ordering, image bags, and cardinality-related operators. The model has a trivial one-variable state with Init setting x to 1 and Next stuttering with UNCHANGED x; there are no temporal properties beyond these state/action definitions, and the main purpose is functional testing of bag operators through TLC expressions and assertions.
